Create a complete 5:18 cinematic narrative music video for the English ballad "WITHOUT EVER HAVING YOU". Synchronize every scene and transition precisely to the supplied song and the timing structure below. Use the uploaded "Behind the Glass" cover as the primary visual reference for the main woman, rain-covered glass, cold blue exterior, warm golden interior and overall emotional atmosphere. Do not reproduce any text from the cover.
FORMAT AND STYLE
16:9 widescreen, photorealistic premium romantic drama, high-end international film production, realistic 35mm texture, 24 fps, elegant anamorphic framing, natural human movement, restrained acting, slow camera movement and seamless cinematic transitions. No performance footage and no singer looking into the camera.
CHARACTER CONTINUITY
Emma is 25 years old, with long dark-brown hair, clear green eyes, fair skin and strong natural eyebrows. Keep exactly the same face, age, body, eye color and hairstyle throughout the entire video.
In warm memories, Emma wears a cream blouse, dark jeans and a light casual coat. At the wedding, she wears an elegant dark navy dress and tailored dark coat. During the rainy finale, she wears the same wedding clothing beneath a charcoal coat; her hair and clothing become naturally wet.
Axel is 28 years old, with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, blue-gray eyes and short dark stubble. Keep exactly the same face, hair and age throughout. In memories he wears a simple dark casual jacket and plain shirt. At the wedding he wears an elegant fitted black formal suit, white shirt and black tie.
The bride wears a refined ivory wedding gown. She remains secondary and is usually shown from behind, in profile or softly out of focus.
00:00–00:07 | INSTRUMENTAL OPENING
Begin on complete black. A narrow line of cold blue light slowly reveals raindrops moving down a large glass window. Behind the glass, a warm golden wedding venue is barely visible as soft bokeh. Slowly dissolve to a white wedding invitation resting beside an unfinished handwritten letter on a dark wooden table. No readable writing.
00:07–00:28 | INTRO
As Emma sings, "Today you're going to say, I do," reveal her sitting alone in the last row of an elegant modern glass wedding venue. She is partially hidden in shadow while Axel and his bride stand far ahead beneath a tasteful floral arch.
On "And I am here, in the very last row," slowly track past empty chairs toward Emma. On "with all the words I never dared to tell you," move into a close-up of her hands holding the unfinished letter inside her handbag. She wants to take it out but stops herself.
00:28–01:11 | VERSE 1 – HIDDEN LOVE
Transition into warm sunlit memories. Show Emma and Axel walking beside a calm river, laughing in a small café, sharing an umbrella during a gentle spring shower and sitting close together on a quiet park bench. Their behavior must feel like genuine longtime friends.
Whenever Axel looks away, Emma watches him with unspoken love. On "I kept your name waiting on my lips," show her almost speaking while they stand close together, but fear stops her.
During "You told me all about the dreams you carried," Axel talks enthusiastically while Emma listens and imagines herself inside the future he describes. End with warm morning sunlight falling across both faces as she realizes that every dream she has includes him.
01:11–01:25 | PRE-CHORUS – THE INVITATION
Return to Emma's apartment before the wedding. She opens a white invitation. Show two elegant names printed side by side, but keep all writing unreadable. Her expression changes as she understands that another woman will live the future she imagined.
Use a slow push-in toward Emma's eyes while the warm memory colors drain into cold blue-gray. The invitation slips from her hand onto the unfinished love letter.
01:25–02:02 | FIRST CHORUS – THE CEREMONY
Return to the wedding. Axel and the bride face one another beneath the floral arch. Emma remains isolated in the last row.
On "She takes the hand I only ever held inside my dreams," show the bride gently taking Axel's hand. Intercut with a brief imagined image of Emma holding that same hand, but let the image dissolve before their fingers fully touch.
On "You promise her a lifetime by your side," show Axel looking sincerely at his bride. On "I hide my broken heart behind a smile," show Emma forcing a small, fragile smile while a single tear remains in her eye.
During "I've lost you without ever having you," slowly widen the frame until Emma appears very small and alone inside the beautiful venue.
02:02–02:16 | VERSE 2 – THE MISSED CHANCE
On "You look so handsome, dressed in your future," show Axel in his formal wedding suit, then transition through his reflection into a memory of the evening outside Emma's home.
Axel stands at her doorway in casual clothing. He senses that she is hiding something and waits for her answer. Emma opens her lips as if she might finally confess, becomes afraid and quietly shakes her head. Axel gives her a gentle smile and walks away. Emma remains in the doorway, immediately regretting her silence.
02:16–02:31 | THE BRIDE APPROACHES
Return to the wedding. The bride walks slowly toward Axel in her ivory gown. Emma watches from the last row.
Match each step of the bride to the music. With every step, insert a brief fading image of something Emma will never have: wearing a wedding dress, placing her hand in Axel's, entering a shared home. Each imagined image disappears before becoming complete.
02:31–02:44 | SECOND PRE-CHORUS – THE DECISION
Axel briefly searches the room and almost meets Emma's eyes. Emma turns away before he can read the truth in her face.
Show her fingers tightening around the hidden letter. For one moment she considers standing and calling his name. She then releases the letter and remains seated, understanding that stopping the wedding would now be selfish.
02:44–03:24 | SECOND CHORUS
Axel and his bride exchange their vows. Keep the ceremony visually quiet and dignified. Guests remain still, distant and indistinct.
On "She takes the hand," use an intimate close-up of their joined hands. On "I only ever held inside my dreams," transition into Emma's imagined hand in the same position, then dissolve back to reality.
During the final two lines of the chorus, slowly circle around Emma while the wedding becomes a soft golden blur behind her. She lowers her eyes and accepts that she has lost him without ever truly having him.
03:24–03:55 | BRIDGE – THE UNLIVED FUTURE
Create a beautiful sequence showing the ordinary life Emma and Axel might have shared.
On "loved you in the open sunlight," show them walking together through a bright summer field.
On "a home too small for two," show them laughing and cooking in a small sunlit apartment.
On "fought over nothing," show a restrained disagreement in the kitchen.
On "made up by midnight," show them quietly reconciling and holding one another beside a dark window.
On "woken every morning next to you," show Emma waking beside Axel in gentle morning light.
These scenes must initially appear completely real. During "love that never finds the strength to speak," reveal that the imagined apartment is empty and Emma is standing there alone. The life they never lived dissolves into floating dust and pale light.
On "I will let you walk away beside her," show Emma finally releasing the unfinished letter from her hand.
03:55–04:33 | FINAL CHORUS
Axel and his bride complete their vows. Emma rises quietly and walks away before the ceremony ends. Do not show anyone reacting to her departure.
Intercut her slow walk through the dark corridor with close-ups of Axel holding his bride's hand. On "the hand I never had the courage to reach for," Emma briefly reaches toward the distant doorway but lowers her hand.
On "I give to you my last and fragile smile," Axel looks toward the back of the room and sees Emma for one final moment. She gives him a small, sincere smile that silently wishes him happiness, then turns away.
As the final line "because I was too scared to say, I love you" rises, Emma steps outside into heavy nighttime rain.
04:33–04:49 | FINALE – ANOTHER LIFE
Emma walks through the rain toward the glass facade of the wedding reception. Warm golden chandeliers glow inside while the exterior remains cold blue and silver.
As she imagines "another life," show faint reflections in the wet glass of the small apartment, morning sunlight and the life she might have shared with Axel. These images should appear only as subtle reflections, then disappear one by one.
On "I'll be the woman by your side," Emma sees her own reflection momentarily standing beside Axel. The reflection fades, leaving the real bride beside him.
04:49–05:10 | OUTRO – BEHIND THE GLASS
Inside the venue, Axel gently takes his bride's face between his hands. Outside, Emma stands close to the rain-covered glass, matching the "Behind the Glass" cover composition. Her reflection overlaps the newly married couple.
On "I lower my eyes," Emma looks down and removes her hand from the glass.
On "And here inside my silence, I finally tell you," slowly move into an extreme close-up through the wet glass. Tears and rain run naturally across her face.
At 05:02, Emma quietly forms the words "I love you." Her lips move naturally and subtly, without performing to the camera.
During "But you can't hear me anymore," show Axel and his bride turning away together inside while Emma remains separated from them by the glass.
05:10–05:18 | FINAL INSTRUMENTAL SECONDS
Emma turns away from the window and walks alone down the rain-soaked street. Use a high, slowly widening camera angle as she becomes smaller beneath the streetlights.
The final image is the empty rain-covered glass. The warm wedding lights remain behind it, but Emma's reflection has disappeared. Fade gradually to complete black exactly on the final note.
COLOR AND CAMERA DIRECTION
Present-day loneliness: midnight blue, charcoal, silver and cold rain reflections.
Warm memories: cream, soft amber, natural sunlight and gentle film grain.
Imagined future: warm gold with subtle soft bloom, remaining photorealistic.
Wedding interior: elegant amber and champagne light.
Final exterior: strong contrast between cold blue rain and warm golden light behind the glass.
Use slow dolly shots, gentle tracking movements, intimate close-ups and carefully composed wide shots. Avoid rapid cutting, exaggerated slow motion and artificial camera movement.
STRICT CONTINUITY AND AUDIO RULES
Use the supplied finished song as the only audio. Generate no dialogue, ambient sound, sound effects or additional music. No clapping, cheering, crowd noise, fan screaming or wedding celebration sounds.
Keep Emma and Axel's faces completely consistent across every time period. Clothing may change only according to the specified timeline. No changing eye colors, hairstyles, ages or body types.
No concert, stage, microphone, singer performance, dancing singer, direct-to-camera singing, subtitles, captions, generated text, logos or watermarks. No fantasy ghosts, supernatural figures, distorted faces, extra limbs, duplicate characters or theatrical crying. The final result must feel like one coherent, emotionally restrained international feature film.
